description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for an Hono Authentication Service supporting SASL PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms. It includes method signatures for authentication procedures, logging, and handling different SASL mechanisms, serving as a foundation for implementing authentication logic in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AbstractHonoAuthenticationService
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for implementing Hono-specific authentication services supporting SASL mechanisms PLAIN and EXTERNAL.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Main method to process authentication requests based on the specified SASL mechanism, delegating to verifyPlain or verifyExternal accordingly.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses implement to verify username/password credentials for SASL PLAIN.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses implement to verify External SASL mechanism, e.g., by verifying a subject DN.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the simple class name for debugging purposes.
